title: Sources: OnePay, a fintech app backed by Walmart and valued at $4B+, has 6M MAUs and $50B in annualized payments, double the figures from the previous year (Paige Smith/Bloomberg)
summary: Paige Smith / Bloomberg: Sources: OnePay, a fintech app backed by Walmart and valued at $4B+, has 6M MAUs and $50B in annualized payments, double the figures from the previous year — Backed by the retailer and Ribbit Capital, OnePay is reaching beyond its initial customer base to take on banks.
